cafes.name: Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters, Khan Market
cafes.description: A specialty coffee roaster's flagship Khan Market outlet with an airy courtyard seating area, single-origin pour-overs and reliable Wi-Fi for laptop-friendly work sessions.

cafes.name: Third Wave Coffee, Connaught Place
cafes.description: A bright, modern chain outlet on Connaught Place's inner circle with communal tables, fast Wi-Fi and plenty of power outlets, popular with students and remote workers alike.
cafes.address: N-Block, Connaught Place, New Delhi, Delhi 110001

cafes.name: Kunzum Travel Café
cafes.description: A pay-as-you-wish travel-themed café in Hauz Khas Village lined with books and maps, hosting regular traveller meetups; a quiet, laid-back spot to read or work between events.
cafes.address: T-49, Hauz Khas Village, New Delhi, Delhi 110016

cafes.name: Café Turtle, Khan Market
cafes.description: A cosy bookstore café above Full Circle Bookstore, serving quiche and coffee among the shelves; a favourite quiet corner for reading and light work away from market noise.

cafes.name: Perch Wine & Coffee Bar
cafes.description: A pastel-toned all-day café-bar in Khan Market with a dedicated coffee and pastry counter by morning, popular for its calm upstairs seating away from the main crowd.
cafes.address: 6, Middle Ln, Khan Market, New Delhi, Delhi 110003

cafes.name: SodaBottleOpenerWala, Khan Market
cafes.description: A Parsi café-bar chain outlet serving berry pulao and bun maska in a nostalgic Bombay-cafe setting, with a relaxed pace that suits laptop work during off-peak hours.

cafes.name: Big Chill Café, Khan Market
cafes.description: A long-running Italian-leaning café known for its indulgent desserts and film-poster-covered walls; seating is snug but the vibe stays relaxed through the afternoon.

cafes.name: AntiSOCIAL, Hauz Khas Village
cafes.description: A daytime café that turns into a live-music basement bar by night, with a rooftop terrace overlooking Hauz Khas lake; mornings and early afternoons stay quiet enough for focused work.
cafes.address: Hauz Khas Village, New Delhi, Delhi 110016

cafes.name: Chaayos, Connaught Place
cafes.description: A popular tea-and-snacks chain outlet on the CP inner circle with customizable kulhad chai, quick Wi-Fi and plentiful seating that stays reliably available through the day.
cafes.address: A-Block, Connaught Place, New Delhi, Delhi 110001

cafes.name: Starbucks Reserve, Connaught Place
cafes.description: A flagship Starbucks Reserve outlet with premium single-origin brews and multiple floors of seating, including quieter upper-level tables suited to longer work sessions.
cafes.address: Radial Rd 1, Connaught Place, New Delhi, Delhi 110001

cafes.name: Depot48, Hauz Khas
cafes.description: A minimalist, industrial-styled café near Hauz Khas with strong espresso-based drinks and communal wooden tables, favoured by nearby design-studio workers for laptop sessions.
cafes.address: Adhchini, Hauz Khas, New Delhi, Delhi 110017

cafes.name: Café Delhi Heights, Vasant Vihar
cafes.description: A spacious, contemporary café-restaurant in Priya Complex with generous booth seating and steady Wi-Fi, popular with South Delhi students during weekday afternoons.
cafes.address: Priya Complex, Vasant Vihar, New Delhi, Delhi 110057

cafes.name: Coffee By Di Bella, GK II
cafes.description: A relaxed neighbourhood café in Greater Kailash II known for Australian-style brunch and consistent coffee, with a small quiet corner good for solo work in the mornings.
cafes.address: M-Block Market, GK II, New Delhi, Delhi 110048

cafes.name: Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters, Lodhi Colony
cafes.description: A converted-market-stall roastery café in Lodhi Colony's Meherchand Market, with outdoor bench seating and single-origin filter coffee brewed to order.
cafes.address: Meherchand Market, Lodhi Colony, New Delhi, Delhi 110003

cafes.name: The Yellow Brick Road Café, Lodhi Colony
cafes.description: A plant-filled all-day café in Meherchand Market with soft lighting and slow service, comfortable for extended reading or writing sessions away from CP's crowds.
cafes.address: Meherchand Market, Lodhi Colony, New Delhi, Delhi 110003

cafes.name: Diggin Café, GK I
cafes.description: A garden-style café tucked into a GK I bungalow with leafy outdoor seating, all-day breakfast and a calm daytime pace before the dinner crowd arrives.
cafes.address: N-Block Market, GK I, New Delhi, Delhi 110048

cafes.name: Wenger's Deli & Verandah Café, Connaught Place
cafes.description: An iconic heritage bakery deli with shaded outdoor verandah seating on Connaught Place, serving freshly brewed artisan coffee, artisanal paninis, and classic pastries.
cafes.address: A-Block, Radial Rd 3, Connaught Place, New Delhi, Delhi 110001
